taxSummary.description: VAT per rate and category, summed from the lines for the response.

nextNumber.description: May be raised, never lowered below the last number issued.

scopePath.description: **The partition key** (ADR-0005). Operations write it at `tenant` scope.

FinTaxInvoiceType.description: 5.7.93. `simplified` for one order with no recipient details, `full` for one order with them, `consolidated` for several paid orders of one buyer on one invoice.
